skip_next_changed: The next occurrence changed. Refresh the schedule and try again.
skip_next_forbidden: Only the owner can skip a scheduled occurrence.
execution_context_unavailable: Cannot verify the task conversation’s execution context. Reconnect its agent and try again.
task_execution_wait_timeout: task_execution_wait_timeout: The selected computer did not support this task’s execution options before the wait expired. Nothing was sent.
unavailable: Can’t read scheduled tasks right now (the database isn’t responding). Try again in a bit.
save_failed: Couldn’t save scheduled tasks. Your change wasn’t applied. Please try again.
task_state_changed: The task state note has changed. Reopen the editor and try again.
daily_title: A daily task needs a title
interval_range: The interval must be between {min} minutes and 7 days
time_passed: That time has passed. Pick a later one.
until_passed: That end time has passed. Pick a later one, or clear it.
missed: Persona was down and missed the time
busy_skipped: The last run is still going, so this one was skipped
busy_wait: The last run is still going. Try again when it’s done.
gone: This scheduled task no longer exists
not_ready_skipped: Your computer or model isn’t set up yet, so this one was skipped
ready_again: Your computer and model are set up, so scheduled tasks run again, starting with “{name}”
ready_again_unnamed: Your computer and model are set up, so scheduled tasks run again
streak: “{name}” hasn’t gone through {count} runs in a row
streak_body: Last one: {reason}. I won’t bring this up again until it goes through once.
deleted_not_again: {id}「{name}」 was deleted by the user while this run was going, so nothing was scheduled. Don't schedule it again; just finish this run.
deleted_elsewhere_not_again: {id}「{name}」 was deleted from another conversation while this run was going, so nothing was scheduled. Don't schedule it again; just finish this run.
waiting_skipped: {name} didn't run this time: its last run is waiting for you
waiting_skipped_body: Its last run is waiting for your approval or answer. Once you handle it, the next run goes as usual. Open it to see what it needs.
cron_empty: Write a cron expression, like 0 9 * * 1-5 (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week)
cron_zone: {cron} sets its own time zone. Leave out TZ= / CRON_TZ=: cron tasks run in your time zone.
cron_every: @every isn’t a cron schedule. To repeat every N minutes (at least {min}), use an interval instead.
cron_alias: {cron} isn’t a cron alias. Use @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly or @yearly, or 5 fields like 0 9 * * 1-5.
cron_fields: {cron} has {n} fields. A cron expression has 5: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week (like 0 9 * * 1-5; seconds aren’t supported).
cron_field: In {cron}, the {field} can’t be {value}. Use a number in its range, *, a list (1,15), a range (9-18) or a step (*/30).
cron_day_of_week: day of week (0–7 or SUN–SAT, 0 and 7 are Sunday)
cron_often: {cron} runs {gap} minutes apart. A scheduled task runs at most every {min} minutes.
cron_never: {cron} never runs: no date in the next 5 years matches it.
execution_offline: The selected computer is offline or unavailable. Reconnect it and try again.
execution_directory: Cannot use this working directory. Check the directory on the selected computer and try again. Details: {error}
execution_directory_whitespace: The working directory has leading or trailing whitespace. Remove it and try again.
execution_health_directory: Health tasks use the Health space folder. Clear the working directory to continue.
execution_own_chat: Turn off “Continue the original chat” to use task execution options, or clear those options to keep following that chat.
run_if_approval: Allow this command to run on the routine’s computer before each scheduled run?
run_if_skipped: The pre-run command asked to skip this run.
retry_unknown: Persona restarted during the automatic retry. Delivery is unknown, so it was not sent again.
todo_no_evidence: No new Agent answer, acceptance-criterion state change or explicit progress report was observed.
todo_stalled_one: {name}: a scheduled check saw no progress. {reason}
todo_stalled_other: {name}: {count} scheduled checks in a row saw no progress. {reason}
todo_baseline: First check since this schedule was linked: what it found is what the next check compares with.
todo_working_one: No reply yet, but the Agent is working: 1 action since {since}, at {at}.
todo_working_other: No reply yet, but the Agent is working: {count} actions since {since}, the latest at {at}.
todo_evidence_quiet: No reply, report, criteria change or other activity since {since}.
todo_evidence_waiting_one: No reply, report or criteria change since {since}; 1 action, a wait or repeat.
todo_evidence_waiting_other: No reply, report or criteria change since {since}; {count} actions, all waits or repeats.
todo_unknown: Progress could not be assessed because the baseline or Agent evidence was unreadable. Run summary: {reason}
todo_save_failed: Could not save progress for {name}. Its no-progress count and escalation may be incomplete. Error: {error}
todo_wait_cost: Another scheduled window may pass without advancing the task.
todo_change_result: Ask the supervisor to propose another approach within the existing permissions.
todo_wait_result: Keep the approved approach and wait for the next scheduled check.
selected_file_unavailable: The selected file is unavailable or its execution context changed. Remove it and choose it again.
file_runtime_unsupported: This agent does not support file selection. Use text or choose another agent.
input_context_unavailable: The task or its original conversation is unavailable. Reopen the task and try again.
execution_antigravity_unavailable: Antigravity is disconnected or unavailable on {machine}. Restore Antigravity on that computer, then run this task again to continue its existing conversation.
execution_space_directory: Tasks in a space use the space's folder. Clear the working directory to continue.
unknown_space: That space is not available for tasks. Choose another space or none.
bad_topic_policy: Choose whether each run starts a new conversation or continues the same one.
space_owner_only: Only you can move a task into or out of a space, from the app.
bad_delivery: Delivery must name channel "feishu" with a valid chat_id and thread_id.
